# NEW 2026-11-22 v16.0 Module 16.0-B: Western Europe 5 Protagonist Pack (oe_w5_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla/D009 overrides). Generated by gen_v160_west_europe.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Zero-slot O(1) yearly kernel hook (invoked once per calendar year from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch).
# Uses strict O(1) country_exists = c:<TAG> lookups (no global country sweeps) and self-deduplicates
# via global_var:oe_w5_ran_y ?= current_year.
oe_w5_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_w5_ran_y ?= current_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_w5_ran_y value = current_year }
		# 1. France (FRA)
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:FRA
				c:FRA = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
			}
			c:FRA = { oe_w5_fra_tick = yes }
		}
		# 2. England / Great Britain (GBR preferred, else ENG)
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:GBR
				c:GBR = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
			}
			c:GBR = { oe_w5_eng_tick = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:ENG
				c:ENG = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
			}
			c:ENG = { oe_w5_eng_tick = yes }
		}
		# 3. Spain (SPA preferred; else CAS, plus ARA if human player or CAS absent; 100% D009 soft-coexisting)
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:SPA
				c:SPA = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
			}
			c:SPA = { oe_w5_spa_tick = yes }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = c:CAS
					c:CAS = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
				}
				c:CAS = { oe_w5_spa_tick = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = c:ARA
					c:ARA = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
					OR = {
						NOT = { country_exists = c:CAS }
						c:ARA = { is_ai = no }
					}
				}
				c:ARA = { oe_w5_spa_tick = yes }
			}
		}
		# 4. Portugal (POR)
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:POR
				c:POR = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
			}
			c:POR = { oe_w5_por_tick = yes }
		}
		# 5. Netherlands (NED preferred, else HOL)
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:NED
				c:NED = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
			}
			c:NED = { oe_w5_ned_tick = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:HOL
				c:HOL = { oe_w5_eligible_actor = yes }
			}
			c:HOL = { oe_w5_ned_tick = yes }
		}
	}
}
